basis: Separate llvm-exegesis instruction probes on CPU 10, five measurements each, mean aggregation. XOR64rr measured 1.00305 cycles; a serial mov/xor/mov chain measured 1.01002 cycles per three-instruction snippet. Same-register MOV measured 1.00163 and is not overridden. Vector instruction measurements are approximately 1 cycle; unchanged. No held-out program timings determine these two integer latency overrides.
